answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the dawn check immediately, the voyage audit keeps the resolved set and the vault replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 98 aliases as a result forfeits the reading cost 98 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
